scripts.setup:photos: cd photos/process_photos && rm -rf .venv && python3.11 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r ./requirements.txt && echo '✅ Setup complete! venv recreated with Python 3.11 and dependencies installed.' && cd ../..
scripts.process:photos: cd photos && . process_photos/.venv/bin/activate && python3 -m process_photos && deactivate && cd ..
scripts.stage:photos: rsync -azh --progress --partial --delete --exclude 'process_photos/' photos/ goat:~/dev.geekofalltrades.org/photos/ && echo 'Photos synced to stage.'
scripts.test:py: cd photos && . process_photos/.venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=. pytest process_photos/tests
scripts.document: npm run document:sass && npm run document:ts && npm run document:php
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n PHP,NPM,CODE,PAGE,PPP,DOCS,STAGE,PHOTOS -c white,gray,blue,cyan,green,yellow,red,magenta "npm run serve:php" "npm run watch:npm" "npm run watch:code" "npm run watch:pages" "npm run watch:ppp" "npm run watch:docs" "npm run watch:stage" "npm run watch:photos"
scripts.stage:code: ssh goat "cd ~/dev.geekofalltrades.org && git pull origin main"
scripts.stage:code:safe: npm run health:local && npm run health:stage && npm run snapshot:stage && npm run stage:code && npm run health:stage && npm run tidy:stage && echo 'Stage deploy OK' || (echo 'Stage deploy FAILED — rolling back' && npm run rollback:stage)
scripts.deploy:update: npm run deploy:update:structure && npm run deploy:update:content
scripts.deploy:safe: npm run health:stage && npm run health:prod && npm run snapshot:prod && npm run deploy:update && npm run health:prod && npm run tidy:prod && echo 'Deploy OK' || (echo 'Deploy FAILED — rolling back' && npm run rollback:prod)
